Bundled with pdfjs-dist 6.0.227 (Apache-2.0), pdf-lib 1.17.1 (MIT), @pdf-lib/fontkit (MIT), opentype.js 2 (MIT).
Bundled for Folia with esbuild on 2026-11-24.
Folia patch: zero-width space glyphs in subset fonts fall back to the standard font's space (fixes words running together).
